title: Integral equation of a normalized supported Kummer boundary
statement: Let A be any commutative coefficient ring, N a natural number with N=0 in A, and T a scheme on which N is invertible. Let i:D→T be a closed immersion with invertible ideal and κ in Ext²(i_* A_D,A_T(1)) satisfy the normalized relative supported Kummer specification [def-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer-boundary]. Write β for the unique integral relative pole-extension class [def-sp-cartier-pole-boundary, lem-sp-cartier-pole-boundary-existence], δ_N for the exact abelian Kummer extension [lem-amb-kummer-any-base], γ_A:i_* Z_D→forget(i_* A_D) for the integral coefficient generator, and ρ_A:μ_N→forget(A_T(1)) for the coefficient root map. Then mk₀(γ_A) composed with forget(κ) equals (β composed with δ_N) composed with mk₀(ρ_A), in Ext²(i_* Z_D,forget(A_T(1))). No finiteness of A or positivity of N is assumed.

source.place: Relative torsor-extension boundary, followed by the final scalar-extension paragraph

proof.text: Evaluate the boundary specification at the complementary open of the closed immersion. Its relative torsor extension is a witness of the integral pole specification for every complementary open, since equality of their underlying subsets identifies these opens. Uniqueness of the pole class identifies the extension class with β. Substitute into the supplied final Ext equation; its Kummer extension and root coefficient map are already the stated ones. This construction is unchanged for empty support, empty schemes, zero rings and N=1.

theorem supported_kummer_integral_equation
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] (N : ℕ) (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    {D T : Scheme.{u}} (i : D ⟶ T) [IsClosedImmersion i] (hI : i.ker.IsInvertible)
    (hT : IsUnit (N : Γ(T, ⊤)))
    (κ : Ext ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) i).obj (ordinaryFiniteConstant A D))
      (finiteEtaleTateLine T N A hA) 2)
    (hκ : SupportedKummerBoundary A N hA i hI hT κ) :
    (Ext.mk₀ (supportedIntegralGenerator A i)).comp
        (κ.mapExactFunctor (RawModuleScalarComparison.forget A T)) (zero_add 2) =
      ((cartierPoleBoundary i hI).comp (T.kummerSequence_shortExact N hT).extClass rfl).comp
        (Ext.mk₀ (ordinaryFiniteRootMap A N hA T)) (add_zero 2)
